course_name_original:
MECB220 
Hochschule Karlsruhe - Technik Und Wirtschaft

learning_outcomes.text: Students can calculate the stress and deformation of mechanical components and systems by learning to analytically apply equilibrium conditions, geometric relationships, and a linear elasticity law to different loading cases.
Students can perform numerical stress analyses using the Finite Element Method (FEM) to dimension mechanical components and systems with respect to strength and safety, depending on the material.

syllabus_topics: Material laws for elasticity and temperature stress
Area moments of inertia and section moduli
Introduction to FEM software (Pre- and Post-Processing)
FEM analysis of a rod system with linear elastic material behavior
FEM analysis of a beam-shaped component with linear elastic material behavior
FEM analysis of a planar component with linear elastic material behavior
Verification of FEM calculations through analytical calculations
FEM analysis of a round tensile specimen considering plastic material behavior
Verification of results for accuracy and plausibility
assessment_rules: The module grade for MECB220 corresponds to the grade of the MECB221 Engineering Mechanics 2 exam.
